title: The Press Room
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Built in 1923 originally as a bowling alley, the space is open and light with a front facade made almost entirely of solid glass. The building later became an automobile showroom and eventually a print shop, where The Press Room gets its name. Urban vibes come from the old brick walls and original steel truss structure, which glitters with lights every night of the year.
